ana: Heads-up: discovered tokenization divergence between SDK 2.8.0 and runtime 3.3.0 for model gptx2 on long prompts. Plan: pin runtime 3.3.0 for gptx2 via canary (1% -> 10% -> 100%) tonight 02:00 UTC; routing fallback to gptx2-quant if errors spike.

luca: do we have a repro and a short description of the failure mode?

ana: repro attached in QC-3377: tokenizer emits a differing split causing trailing function-call tokens to shift. Not a crash but generation mismatches and downstream function parsing breaks. Example diff: ```
input: "Summarize the following: [very long doc...]"
expected tokens tail: "...,\n]"
observed tokens tail: "...,]"  // missing newline token leads to parse mismatch
```

ops_jun: if function-call offsets shift this is risky for customers using structured tool calls. Start with 1% canary in eu-west and run our offset/eval suite.

deploy-bot: command received: `pin runtime 3.3.0 --model gptx2 --canary 1% --regions eu-west --note "tokenizer divergence mitigation"`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6162228001). Will post status.

eng-qa: we'll run offset-check and function-call hash tests; posting script: ```
# offset-check.sh
python tests/offset_check.py --model gptx2 --endpoint https://canary.eu-west.api --runs 50
```

support_bot: auto-notify: @support prepped with advisory draft.

deploy-bot: canary job complete (job=JB6162228001)  02:07 UTC  status=OK

eng-qa: canary results: 50 runs, 3 mismatches (6%). Baseline expectation <1% for production. Mismatches are function-call offset shifts by 1 token. Artifacts saved to QC-3377.

luca: that's above threshold. Do not continue to 10%. We should revert canary immediately and prepare an SDK tokenizer parity fix.

ops_jun: revert command running. deploy-bot, please unpin eu-west.

deploy-bot: revert command received: `unpin runtime 3.3.0 --model gptx2 --regions eu-west --mode force`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6162228002)
deploy-bot: revert complete (job=JB6162228002)  02:25 UTC  status=OK

eng-sre: telemetry confirms offset error rates back to baseline; no 5xx spikes.

ana: drafting postmortem blurb: "Attempted phased pin of runtime 3.3.0 for gptx2 to mitigate tokenizer drift. Canary telemetry showed function-call offset regressions for long prompts; we reverted in eu-west and will ship an SDK tokenizer parity fix. No customer-facing incidents observed."

luca: include mitigation guidance for customers relying on function-calls: suggest pinning SDK 2.7.x client or use header `x-runtime-fallback=gptx2-quant` until fix ships.

support_bot: posted advisory draft to #support-drafts and pinged @support.

ops_jun: holding the night window for full rollout until SDK patch lands and CI green. We'll reopen this thread once SDK PR merged and canary plan updated.

eng-qa: filed QC-3377 with repro details and failing example request for SDK team.

ana: thanks all. Please leave this thread open until we have SDK PR green and a follow-up canary plan.
